name: sqldw-authoring-cli
description: > Execute authoring T-SQL (DDL, DML, data ingestion, transactions, schema changes) against Microsoft Fabric Data Warehouse and SQL endpoints via the MCP `fabric-sqlendpoint-execute_query` tool. Use when the user wants to: (1) create/alter/drop tables, (2) insert/update/delete/merge data, (3) run COPY INTO or OPENROWSET ingestion, (4) manage transactions or stored procedures, (5) perform schema evolution, (6) use time travel or snapshots, (7) generate ETL/ELT workflows, (8) create views/functions
author: microsoft
summary_zh: 通过 MCP 在 Microsoft Fabric 数据仓库和 SQL 端点执行 T-SQL，适合建表、数据写入、模式变更及 ETL/ELT 等场景。
